newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway sets up cooperation body for exploration.
newsitem.headline: Norway sets up cooperation body for exploration.

text.p: A forum for exploration technology in Norway has been established under the initiative of the Norwegian Petroleum Directorate (NPD), state-owned Den norske stats oljeselskap AS said on Thursday.
Called Find, the body aims to increase collaboration between oil companies in areas such as planning and executing technology projects related to exploring Norway's continental shelf.

"The exploration phase has traditionally been regarded as competitive, with only limited cooperation between palyers, but now conditions appear to be more favourable to enhance collaboration, Statoil's Status Weekly newsletter said.

"Our aim with Find is to create a neutral meeting place for the 20 oil companies active off Norway, and it has been successful so far," said Finn Aamodt, NPD exploration director. "All the companies are interested in participating."

Two projects already have been initiated. The first, known as Super Grid, seeks to create a national database with a common coordinate system for existing and future three-dimensional seismic information.
The second project will identify critical factors for exploration success off Norway.
Norwegian Energy Minister Grete Faremo will formally open the Find forum on January 28.
